newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil Co Q4 profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil Co Q4 profit vs loss.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
Note: Oper net for the quarter, excluding nonrecurring items, is $33 million, or $0.70 a share, versus net of $9 million, or $0.18 a share.
1996 year oper net was $101 million, or $2.17 per share, compared to an adjusted loss of $8 million, or $0.17 a share, for 1995.

1996 includes $33 million primarily from gains on the sale of various noncore assets last year. The 1995 results include $297 million in after-tax nonrecurring charges for adoption of a new accounting standard and other nonrecurring items.

Recurring operating income increased in 1996 primarily as a result of increased natural gas and crude oil prices and lower costs. Production costs declined to $4.41 per barrel of oil equivalent from $5.09 in 1995.
Net includes income from continuing operations, in quarter, gain $28,461,000 vs charge $27,809,000. In year, gain $133,898,000 vs charge $305,142,000
